zizhitongjian:083:s0346.en: Xiu was made Attendant and General Who Assists the State, retaining his posts as Chancellor's Major and Colonel of the Right.
zizhitongjian:083:s0346.literal: Sun Xiu was further made Attendant and General Who Assists the State, retaining his posts as Chancellor's Major and Colonel of the Right.

zizhitongjian:083:s0347.en: Zhang Lin and others all held prominent posts.
zizhitongjian:083:s0347.literal: Zhang Lin and the rest all held prominent posts.

zizhitongjian:083:s0348.zh: 增相府兵為二萬人，與宿衛同，並所隱匿之兵，數逾三萬。
zizhitongjian:083:s0348.en: Chancellor household troops were raised to twenty thousand, equal to the palace guard; with hidden forces the total exceeded thirty thousand.
zizhitongjian:083:s0348.literal: The chancellor's household troops were increased to twenty thousand, equal to the palace guard, and with hidden troops as well the number exceeded thirty thousand.

zizhitongjian:083:s0350.zh: 倫及諸子皆頑鄙無識，秀狡黠貪淫，所與共事者，皆邪佞之士，惟競榮利，無深謀遠略，志趣乖異，互相憎嫉。
zizhitongjian:083:s0350.en: Lun and his sons were dull and vulgar; Xiu was cunning, greedy, and lewd. Their associates were corrupt men who sought only profit, without foresight, mutually hostile.
zizhitongjian:083:s0350.literal: Lun and his sons were all obtuse and vulgar without understanding; Xiu was cunning, greedy, and licentious; those who worked with them were all depraved men who competed only for glory and profit, without deep plans or far sight, their aims divergent and mutually hateful.

zizhitongjian:083:s0351.zh: 秀子會為射聲校尉，形貌短陋，如奴僕之下者，秀使尚帝女河東公主。
zizhitongjian:083:s0351.en: Xiu's son Hui, Colonel of the Archers, was short and ugly as a menial, yet Xiu married him to the Princess of Hedong.
zizhitongjian:083:s0351.literal: Xiu's son Hui was Colonel of the Archers; short and ugly in form, like one beneath a slave—yet Xiu had him marry the emperor's daughter, the Princess of Hedong.

zizhitongjian:083:s0334.zh: 齊王冏以功遷游擊將軍，冏意不滿，有恨色。
zizhitongjian:083:s0334.en: Jiong was promoted to General of the Reserves for his merit but was dissatisfied and showed resentment.
zizhitongjian:083:s0334.literal: The Prince of Qi Jiong was transferred to General of the Reserves for his merit, but Jiong was dissatisfied and showed resentment.

zizhitongjian:083:s0335.zh: 孫秀覺之，且憚其在內，乃出為平東將軍，鎮許昌。
zizhitongjian:083:s0335.en: Xiu noticed and, fearing him in the capital, posted him out as General Who Pacifies the East at Xuchang.
zizhitongjian:083:s0335.literal: Sun Xiu noticed it and, also fearing him within the capital, sent him out as General Who Pacifies the East, stationed at Xuchang.

zizhitongjian:083:s0349.zh: 九月，改司徒為丞相，以梁王肜為之，肜固辭不受。
zizhitongjian:083:s0349.en: In the ninth month the post of Minister over the Masses was renamed Chancellor for Rong, Prince of Liang, who firmly declined.
zizhitongjian:083:s0349.literal: In the ninth month the Minister over the Masses was renamed Chancellor, with the Prince of Liang Rong to hold it; Rong firmly declined and would not accept.

zizhitongjian:083:s0352.zh: 冬，十一月，甲子，立皇后羊氏，赦天下。
zizhitongjian:083:s0352.en: In winter, the eleventh month, on jiazi, Lady Yang was made empress and the realm amnestied.
zizhitongjian:083:s0352.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on the day jiazi, Lady Yang was established as empress and the realm was granted amnesty.

zizhitongjian:083:s0353.zh: 後，尚書郎泰山羊玄之之女也。
zizhitongjian:083:s0353.en: She was the daughter of Yang Xuanzhi, Gentleman of the Masters of Writing of Taishan.
zizhitongjian:083:s0353.literal: The empress was the daughter of Yang Xuanzhi, Gentleman of the Masters of Writing of Taishan.

zizhitongjian:083:s0354.zh: 外祖平南將軍樂安孫旂，與孫秀善，故秀立之。
zizhitongjian:083:s0354.en: Her maternal grandfather was Sun Qi, General Who Pacifies the South of Le'an, friendly with Xiu, which is why Xiu made her empress.
zizhitongjian:083:s0354.literal: Her maternal grandfather was Sun Qi, General Who Pacifies the South of Le'an, on good terms with Sun Xiu, and therefore Xiu established her.

zizhitongjian:083:s0355.zh: 拜玄之光祿大夫、特進、散騎常侍，封興晉侯。
zizhitongjian:083:s0355.en: Xuanzhi was made Household Grandee, Special Courtier, Gentleman of the Encampment, and Marquis of Xingjin.
zizhitongjian:083:s0355.literal: Xuanzhi was appointed Household Grandee, Special Courtier, and Gentleman of the Encampment, enfeoffed as Marquis of Xingjin.

zizhitongjian:083:s0383.zh: 廞自稱大都督，大將軍、益州牧，署置僚屬，改易守令。
zizhitongjian:083:s0383.en: Xin styled himself Grand Commander-in-Chief, Grand General, and Governor of Yi, appointed staff, and replaced local officials.
zizhitongjian:083:s0383.literal: Xin styled himself Grand Commander-in-Chief, Grand General, and Governor of Yi Province, appointed staff, and changed the garrison commanders and magistrates.

zizhitongjian:083:s0384.en: When court officials were summoned, none dared refuse.
zizhitongjian:083:s0384.literal: When court officials were summoned none dared not go.

zizhitongjian:083:s0385.zh: 李庠帥妹婿李含、天水任回、上官昌、扶風李攀、始平費他、氐苻成、隗伯等四千騎歸廞。
zizhitongjian:083:s0385.en: Li Xiu led Li Han, Ren Hui, Shangguan Chang, Li Pan, Fei Ta, Fu Cheng, Wei Bo, and four thousand horsemen to join Xin.
zizhitongjian:083:s0385.literal: Li Xiu led his brothers-in-law Li Han of Tianshui, Ren Hui, Shangguan Chang, Li Pan of Fufeng, Fei Ta of Shiping, the Di Fu Cheng, and Wei Bo and others with four thousand horsemen to join Xin.

zizhitongjian:083:s0386.zh: 廞以庠為威寇將軍，封陽泉亭侯，委以心膂，使招合六郡壯勇至萬餘人，以斷北道。
zizhitongjian:083:s0386.en: Xin made Xiu General Who Subdues Bandits and Marquis of Yangquan, trusted him deeply, and had him gather more than ten thousand braves of six commanderies to block the northern road.
zizhitongjian:083:s0386.literal: Xin made Xiu General Who Subdues Bandits and Marquis of Yangquan Pavilion, entrusted him as close confidant, and had him gather braves of the six commanderies to more than ten thousand to cut the northern road.
